title: Source Identification Is Not Fitness Testing: Measuring the Limits of Synthetic-Data Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2610.00417v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repeated training on model-generated data can degrade later models. One possible response is to use provenance when deciding which generated examples to reuse. We test both how reliably that provenance can be recovered and whether it helps identify better training data. Using financial-risk text, we first identify the source of generated passages and then repeat the test after rewriting them. Generator attribution is 98.7% accurate on the original passages but falls to 53.1% after paraphrasing and 29.0% after style rewriting. Generated-versus-human detection remains close to perfect against the tested human comparison set. We then compare two ways of selecting generated examples over three rounds of generation and retraining. One uses source information. The other uses a score from a separate reference model. translated_title: 来源识别并非适应性测试：度量合成数据归因的极限
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.00417v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在模型生成的数据上反复训练可能会降低后续模型的性能。一种可能的应对方法是在决定复用哪些生成样本时利用数据来源信息。我们测试了这种来源信息能被多可靠地恢复，以及它是否能帮助识别更优质的训练数据。基于金融风险文本，我们首先识别生成段落的来源，随后在将这些段落改写后重复该测试。生成器归因在原始段落上的准确率为98.7%，但在同义改写后降至53.1%，在风格改写后进一步降至29.0%。而在与所测试的人类对照集比较时，生成内容与人类内容的判别仍然接近完美。随后，我们在三轮生成与再训练过程中比较了两种选择生成样本的方法：一种利用来源信息，另一种使用来自独立参考模型的评分。这两种规则会选择不同的样本，但计划的对比实验未能检测到二者在模型退化方面存在稳定差异……
tldr: 研究表明合成数据来源归因在文本改写后会大幅失效（准确率从98.7%降至29.0%），且基于来源的数据筛选相比基于参考模型评分的筛选并不能稳定缓解模型退化，说明来源识别不能替代对数据质量的适应性测试。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that synthetic-data source attribution collapses under paraphrasing (from 98.7% to 29.0% accuracy) and that source-based data selection shows no stable advantage over reference-model scoring in mitigating model degradation, proving that source identification is not a substitute for fitness testing.
